what: Plan appends the launcher-lib paths to migrated-scripts.tsv and deletes them, but the file list omits tracked references in agent-lint and the vendor-diagnostics flush contract.
scenario_or_breakage: After the PR deletes those paths, make lint-retired-scripts scans tracked files and will still find retired path strings outside the manifest, so the required retired-script lint cannot pass.
suggested_fix: Add agent-lint.toml and scripts/flush-vendor-failure-diagnostics.{sh,md} to the update list, remove obsolete dead-script suppressions for deleted files, and retarget the flush comments/docs to the Python agents.py diagnostics helpers without naming retired paths.
